_locked: Locked 6 Oct 2026 by the decision that graph drawings use one locked style, laid out by Graphviz. Change a value only with a new decision that names what it reverses.
_about: Presentation for graph_svg.py — the graph drawings in notes. Edit here, never in the script. Colours are Obsidian theme variables, so a drawing follows light and dark mode. Each kind of thing takes a hue in kind_hues chosen from its name (kinds keep the colour they had when they first appeared; red and green are kept for the for/against readings); kind_colours pins a kind to a hue. Each relationship reading takes a hue in edge_hues chosen from its name, and its label matches its line, so a label can always be matched to its link. edge_colours pins readings whose colour carries meaning: green for, red against — which is why green and red are kept out of edge_hues. page_width is the width a drawing should fit without shrinking (Obsidian's readable line width); each graph is laid out in every direction listed and the least-shrunk wins, unless it would be taller than max_height_ratio times its width. A drawing is sized as Mermaid sizes its own — full width, capped at natural size — and zoom handles small text.
_readability: Checked 6 Oct 2026. line_height 1.25: lines inside a box spaced 1.25x the font size — the spacing for labels in diagrams and interfaces (1.2-1.3x), not for paragraphs (1.4-1.5x); at 1.5x the lines of one box read as separate sentences. Graphviz's own was about 1.0x. caption_gap 3 (points): space between the kind caption and the text. caption_letter_spacing 0.08 (em): capitals need tracking, about 5-10%. box_padding 0.24,0.15 (inches): about 1.4 em across and 0.9 em up and down. font_size 12.5 pt (about 17 px), kind_font_size 9 pt (12 px, the smallest text), edge_font_size 10.5 pt (14 px), all at natural size. label_mix 50 and line_mix 75: each hue blended with the theme's text colour to that percentage, so labels reach 4.5:1 contrast (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3) and lines and borders 3:1 (SC 1.4.11) in both themes — measured on Obsidian's default themes at 5.4:1 and 3.2:1 or better.
